visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair and earrings, wearing a light grey Levi's sweatshirt, appears in a medium shot. He speaks directly to the camera with high energy, using frequent hand gestures. The background is a blurred image of a red Japanese-style bridge under a blue sky. (2) The scene cuts to another young man with similar features wearing a black and white striped shirt over a black t-shirt. He listens attentively, touching his chin in a thinking pose. The background is a bright, white studio setting. (3) A yellow text box with black and red text appears in the center, framing the main topic. The man in the grey sweater continues his narrative, his facial expressions shifting from curiosity to excitement. (4) Throughout the video, the two men alternate on screen in a shot-reverse-shot style. Cartoon-style graphics are overlaid at specific moments, such as an illustration of children playing a board game on a green mat or a man praying at a traditional Japanese shrine. (5) In a comedic sequence near the end, the man in the grey sweater is shown in a black and white filter, appearing distressed or exhausted. He later holds up a bunch of red and yellow toy firecrackers while the man in the striped shirt reacts with exaggerated shock and loud gestures, waving his hands to emphasize his point.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 如何分辨台灣人 (過新年的差異). (2) [Subtitle]: 可以跟你說件事嗎？ (3) [Subtitle]: 怎麼了？ (4) [Subtitle]: 我想和一個朋友一起過新年. (5) [Subtitle]: 但我搞不清楚他到底是日本人還是台灣人. (6) [Subtitle]: 那我來幫你分析一下. (7) [Subtitle]: 你跟我說說他有什麼特徵？ (8) [Subtitle]: 首先 因為是過年嘛 朋友提議玩遊戲. (9) [Subtitle]: 就開始擲骰子. (10) [Subtitle]: 那應該是日本人吧. (11) [Subtitle]: 日本的新年會測試運氣. (12) [Subtitle]: 比如玩雙陸棋或是. (13) [Subtitle]: 他把杯子倒過來 開始擲骰子了. (14) [Subtitle]: 哦 那是台灣人. (15) [Subtitle]: 這叫「吹牛」. (16) [Subtitle]: 是一種比誰更會騙人的遊戲. (17) [Subtitle]: 這絕對是台灣人. (18) [Subtitle]: 有一個人當主持 大家圍成一圈玩. (19) [Subtitle]: 他是日本人吧. (20) [Subtitle]: 那是日本有名的百人一首遊戲. (21) [Subtitle]: 主持人會念短歌的上句 大家搶下句的紙牌. (22) [Subtitle]: 這是典型的日本人過年活動. (23) [Subtitle]: 可是主持人突然說「天黑請閉眼」. (24) [Subtitle]: 哦 那是台灣人. (25) [Subtitle]: 這是狼人殺的開場白. (26) [Subtitle]: 目的是隱藏自己是狼的身分. (27) [Subtitle]: 然後互相騙來騙去. (28) [Subtitle]: 這遊戲在台灣超級流行. (29) [Subtitle]: 連綜藝節目都常常在玩. (30) [Subtitle]: 這人肯定是台灣人. (31) [Subtitle]: 不過 隨著時間過去 大家玩得越來越激烈. (32) [Subtitle]: 最後都快吵起來了... (33) [Subtitle]: 那絕對是台灣人！ (34) [Subtitle]: 你去熱炒店看 隔壁桌的大叔們也是玩得大吼大叫. (35) [Subtitle]: 真的很嚇人. (36) [Subtitle]: 這不就是個遊戲嗎 開心玩不就好了！ (37) [Subtitle]: 說是騙來騙去 他們可是十分認真的... (38) [Subtitle]: 台灣人真的太愛騙來騙去了吧！ (39) [Subtitle]: 從吹牛到狼人殺 都是這種騙人的遊戲. (40) [Subtitle]: 過年應該玩點和平的遊戲吧～ (41) [Subtitle]: 對了 他說為了祈求和平 他有件想做的事. (42) [Subtitle]: 日本的話會去初次參拜神社、對嘛. (43) [Subtitle]: 他說要做這種比較祥和的活動？ (44) [Subtitle]: 不是 他說要放鞭炮. (45) [Subtitle]: 這一點都不和平啊！！！ (46) [Subtitle]: 通宵放鞭炮 聲音吵得完全睡不著！ (47) [Subtitle]: 我第一次聽到的時候 還以為外面發生什麼事件了！ (48) [Subtitle]: 你這朋友 一定是台灣人！
